I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That figure comes from #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, a channel Dana is in. She first posted 180, then corrected it a few minutes later to "It's 185, not 180." I couldn't find the signed amendment in any files I can open, so I haven't checked the number against the document itself. I suggested she confirm with June Osei-Lark, who was sent the signed copy, before the deck goes out.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it didn't need approval.
